# UploadFile — Cobalt source template

<!-- Generated by tools/content.mjs from MDX and source; do not edit. -->

A drag-and-drop / click-to-browse file upload field that toggles between an empty drop zone and a selected-file preview card. It renders two distinct states: an empty drop zone when no file is selected, and a file card when a file has been chosen. Drag-over triggers a visual highlight on the drop zone border and background.

## Copy and adapt

This is editable source, not an installable library. Never install `@openpencil/cobalt-extensions` or import that package name. Official `@talkdesk/*` dependencies are separate.

Before reuse, read the complete implementation, types, styles and local imports listed below. For a standalone/existing app, run the bundled `cobalt-project.mjs copy-source --out <project>`; it copies source without installing dependencies or replacing existing files.
